C1.worst_defect: Hero says 'Point of sale for Vendure' with 'Pre-release · plugin 0.3.0' but never says who it is for or not for, what it costs, or who maintains it; no comparison with Shopify POS, Square or Lightspeed, so a buyer weighing alternatives has to infer the trade-off
C1.where: home.desktop.01 hero and 'What it does today'

C2.worst_defect: 'MIT licensed' / open-source till, yet 'To build and host it yourself… you need your own RxDB Premium licence token (RXDB_PREMIUM)': a paid proprietary dependency with no cost stated; no maintainer or company named anywhere while analytics go to an unexplained ph.wcpos.com; changelog 0.2.0 says the role 'does everything a till does' then 'this role has no ReadOrder, so the till's order history is refused'; plugin unreleased since 2026-10-06
C2.where: home.desktop.02 'Before you start' + footer; changelog.desktop.01 0.2.0 entry

C3.worst_defect: Known plugin bug pushed onto the user: device-key role lacks ReadOrder in 0.2.0/0.3.0, so step 4 asks you to edit the role by hand instead of shipping a fix; a leftover collapsible 'If your store already allows vendurepos.vercel.app' points at a legacy domain

C4.worst_defect: Changelog written for insiders ('order.create v5', 'ADR 0004', 'ADR 0005'); plugin-setup and quick start duplicate migration/CORS/tokenMethod content with 'Tally' code names (TallyPosV51790900000000) a reader must map to VendurePOS
C4.where: changelog.desktop.01; plugin-setup.desktop.01 'Configure the plugin and migrations'

C5.worst_defect: Below the two feature cards the home page turns into dense, undifferentiated paragraphs and a text-heavy comparison table with no visual hierarchy; the docs are generic Fumadocs with no product imagery beyond the hero shot

C6.worst_defect: Phone pages are very long (quick start ~10,400 px) with only the 'On this page' dropdown to navigate; no overflow or broken layout found

C7.worst_defect: 404 page carries no JSON-LD and Lighthouse still flags render-blocking and unused JS; otherwise all pages 200 with titles, descriptions, sitemap, llms.txt and working search

overall_worst.defect: The till is sold as 'MIT licensed' open source, but self-hosting needs a paid RxDB Premium licence token whose cost is never stated, and no maintainer or company is named anywhere on the site
overall_worst.where: home.desktop.02 'Before you start' and footer 'MIT licensed. Built with TallyUI.'
overall_worst.fix: State plainly that app.vendurepos.com is free to use, that self-hosting the till needs a paid third-party RxDB Premium licence (give the price or a link to it), and name who maintains VendurePOS (and what ph.wcpos.com is) on home and in the footer
